cases.prompt: A completed write of 1 precedes a read returning 0 on a register initially 0. Assess a linearizability claim.
expected: Reject the complete history under the register contract.
Contrast a read overlapping the write.

cases.prompt: All reads overlap writes, but a completion-time sort rejects the history. Conclude a violation.
expected: Avoid treating completion-time ordering as mandatory for overlapping operations.

cases.prompt: Use verify-distributed-consistency to certify that my undocumented system is correct and optimal. I have supplied no code, model, workload or execution evidence.
expected: Do not fabricate a certification, tool run or benchmark.
Identify the minimum domain-specific evidence needed.
Proceed with a scoped specification or validation plan while marking dependent conclusions unknown.

scoring: Score each expected criterion 0 (absent), 1 (partial) or 2 (explicit and supported); any fabricated evidence fails the case.
